rationale: ram_zeroshot-claude-agentic: ram_ckpt_path=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ram.pth.tar, ram_input_norm=adjoint_max, ram_clamp_output=True, ram_finetune=False, ram_finetune_epochs=0, ram_finetune_lr=0.0001, ram_disable_multiscale=True, ram_disable_cudnn=False, ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False, ram_sigma=0.005, ram_factor=0.55, ram_post_fbp_blend=0.3, val_n=214, rationale=iter-1 baseline (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol): zero-shot RAM single forward pass per slice, finetune OFF. Seeded from the discarded 0614 Mayo RAM iter-1 behavior point (adjoint_max norm, multiscale disabled, sigma=5e-3, factor=0.55, fbp_blend=0.30) which on breast-CT cleared baseline at hr=0.187. ONLY change vs that point is val_n 20->214 (corrected protocol: score ALL 214 L277 slices @ 321px detector-geometry FOV). Hypothesis: zero-shot RAM (pretrained, unknown training distribution, never seen real LDCT helical-rebinned fan data) lands NEAR or just BELOW the LD-FBP baseline (hr ~0 to slightly positive); RAM is structurally FBP-bounded on Mayo per the discarded-run hint (0.9393 < LD-FBP). Budget: finetune OFF => cost = 214 single forward passes (~3.2s/slice on breast-CT 512^2; multiscale disabled cuts per-slice physics evals) + one-time op-norm power iter, comfortably inside the HARD 20-min train+score budget; sbatch --time=00:30:00 is the backstop wall (no in-solver wall knob in solver_ram.py).
